scope: machine-readable reconciliation of the 20bf5b3 full snapshot vs normalized 7afe7fb JSONL vs local-source audit receipt
normalized_duplicate_semantics: seen_fingerprints keys on sha256 of the raw normalized JSONL line bytes within one source_id; a duplicate is an exact byte-identical record, never a semantic near-duplicate

wiki_links.example: source page 10 -> resolved page 49309; the same physical link row (same source_id, same target, same resolved_id) appears in multiple page body dumps

unresolved_wiki_links.example: page 105 'ukagaka' -> target 'Teddy (ukagaka)' with resolved_id null; identical row duplicated across page bodies
unresolved_wiki_links.explanation: 79947 - 952 duplicates = 78995 unique unresolved rows; no unresolved record was dropped or merged by content change

entity_records.note: one entity record per (tag_key, source table) across 7 occurrence groups plus alias/annotation tables; distinct tag EntryKeys are fewer because the same tag_key appears in multiple groups; groups are stored as occurrences, not identities

wiki_match_candidate_links.multiplicity: every distinct candidate line appears exactly twice in the normalized file (multiplicity distribution {2: 96747})
wiki_match_candidate_links.example: tag 'akanbe' -> wiki page 5438, match_type exact_title, confidence 1.0, dataset_id NULL
wiki_match_candidate_links.explanation: the frozen tag_evidence table itself contains each (tag_key, wiki_id, matched_text) row twice with identical bytes; both copies were emitted and the importer deduplicated byte-identical lines. No dataset/evidence/locator was lost: the 96747 distinct raw rows fully account for all 193494 input lines.

credit_person_subject_person.note: subject-persons rows reference person or subject IDs not present as entities in the same archive cut

subject_relation_subject_subject.note: subject-relations rows referencing subjects outside the archive cut (external or deleted subjects)

unresolved_breakdown.classification: all are archive-internal reference gaps (endpoint entity absent from the same cut), not adapter key encoding errors: every checked endpoint namespace/value pair matches the archive's own ID scheme

breakdown.classification: bangumi character IDs absent from the bangumi archive cut; candidate links are never promoted

audit_binding.note: per-source input -> normalized -> build hash chain is recorded in the manifest source entries; source_rows counts in the manifest bind to these audit-observed figures
